motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and reveals.

motion.purpose: Upper bound; calm crossfade for a newly-surfaced stale item. Never a pulse.

components.name: Inferred Field Mark
components.description: A model-inferred, user-unconfirmed value. Dotted underline + 'inferred' label in Secondary-text; trust is never signaled by hue alone.

narrative.overview: A precision instrument wearing a sober institutional brand. Deep Indigo gravitas on a clean near-white canvas, one warm Amber signal for what needs you now, and everything legible at a glance. The interface recedes: Indigo and a disciplined Slate ramp do the structural work, Amber is spent like scarce currency, and the one next thing is always obvious. Time pressure is shown quietly through a muted Secondary-text gray, position, weight, and plain words, never red, badges, or volume. Red exists in exactly one place: destructive confirmation. There is no green in the palette, so done and confirmed are signaled by an Indigo check and a solid-vs-muted treatment, never an invented success color.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, trustworthy, precise, in a sober institutional voice.
Indigo is the structural brand; Amber is the one scarce signal; the rest is a Slate ramp.
Quiet by default: time pressure shown through tone, placement, and words, never alarm.
Flat and precise: hairline borders, small radius, near-zero shadow.
Aptos two-voice type: Aptos Sans operates, Aptos Serif narrates.
Motion conveys state in 150 to 250ms, never choreography; full reduced-motion alternatives.
Responsive and phone-first: the cockpit is read on a phone between meetings.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Amber appears on at most 10% of any screen and only means 'this is what's next / active.' Primary actions and brand are Indigo, not Amber. If two things are Amber, neither is 'next.'

rules.name: The No-Alarm Rule
rules.body: Overdue, slipping, and stale are forbidden from using Errors-red, Rose, or any accent. Red means 'you are about to destroy something.' Time pressure is carried by Secondary-text gray, upward placement, and plain wording, never alarm color, badges, or saturation.

rules.name: The Inferred Ink Rule
rules.body: Inferred-but-unconfirmed values render in Secondary-text gray with a dotted underline and an 'inferred' tag; confirmed values render solid in Slate with an Indigo check. There is no success-green; trust is signaled by weight, check, and tag, never hue alone.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Aptos Sans operates, Aptos Serif narrates. Anything the user clicks, types into, or reads as data is Aptos Sans. A serif label on a control is forbidden.

rules.name: The Provenance Inset Rule
rules.body: Every verbatim source quote sits in a tinted inset block, italic, visually distinct from the model's paraphrased item text above it. Provenance must look quoted and literal.

rules.name: The Flat & Precise Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest with a small radius (2 to 8px, architectural, not pill-soft). Shadow only on popovers, dropdowns, and modals. Depth between a row and its background is one tonal step plus a hairline, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep Amber under 10% of any screen and only for 'what's next / active'; make primary buttons Indigo, not Amber.
Do show time pressure with Secondary-text gray, upward placement, and plain words.
Do put verbatim quotes in a tinted inset (italic), mark inferred values with a dotted underline + 'inferred' tag, and confirmed values with an Indigo check.
Do keep surfaces flat with hairline borders and small radius; reach for shadow only on the picker, popovers, and modals.
Do distinguish owner type, inferred-vs-confirmed, and stale state by icon, label, and weight, not hue alone.
Do set all dates, counts, and figures in tabular numerals so columns align.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce alternative; transitions 150 to 250ms, ease-out, state-only.
Do hold all text to AA: body and placeholders at Secondary-text (#706C82) or darker, never Slate Medium for small text.
donts: Don't build a loud nagging productivity app: no red badges, no notification counts, no streaks, no overdue shaming. Escalation varies form, never volume.
Don't use Errors-red or Rose for overdue, slipping, or stale, ever. Red is destructive-confirm only.
Don't invent a success-green; the palette has none. Done/confirmed is an Indigo check plus solid-vs-muted treatment.
Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard: no hero-metric template, no gradient text, no identical card grids, no glassmorphism.
Don't build a cluttered enterprise tool: never show everything at one density with nothing prioritized.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe on cards, rows, or callouts.
Don't put Aptos Serif on any control the user operates; serif narrates, sans operates.
Don't stack drop shadows on at-rest surfaces; depth is the tonal step plus hairlines.
Don't add cute or gamified flourishes; this is a trust-first institutional instrument.
Don't use em dashes in any user-facing copy.
